title: 16S rRNA Library Prep for Nanopore MinION
author: Somasundhari Shanmuganandam
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6j6hcre
materials: Add the reagents below in the same order in a fresh 0.8 ml PCR strip tube 2
Adding the following reagents in the same order as below
Add the reagents in following order and flick between addition of each reagents aeR

steps.title: Perform 16S rRNA PCR
steps.instruction: Set up a 100 µl PCR reaction using the following components for a 25 µl reaction scale: 5 µl Template DNA (2.3 ng), 15 µl nuclease-free water, 25 µl Q5 high fidelity PCR Master Mix, 2.5 µl 10 µM forward primer, and 2.5 µl 10 µM reverse primer.

substeps.instruction: Initial denaturation: 98°C for 30 sec
28 cycles of: 98°C for 10 sec, 55°C for 15 sec, 72°C for 40 sec
Final extension: 72°C for 5 min

steps.title: Clean up PCR Product
steps.instruction: Purify the PCR product using AMPure XP beads and 70% ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 20 ml of fresh 70% ethanol in nuclease-free water.
Add 1 volume (100 µl) of resuspended beads to each PCR reaction and mix by flicking.
Incubate on a Hula mixer for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Spin down and pellet on a 96-well magnet rack; pipette off the supernatant.
Wash beads with 200 µl of fresh 70% ethanol using a multichannel pipette without disturbing the pellet; remove and discard ethanol. Repeat.
Spin down, place on magnet, and pipette off residual ethanol.
Air dry for 3-5 minutes.
Resuspend pellet in 15 µl nuclease-free water and incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Pellet beads on magnet until the eluate is clear and colorless.

steps.title: Verify and Quantify DNA
steps.instruction: Ensure the cleaned product is free from primers, RNA, and protein contamination.

substeps.instruction: Run 3 µl of cleaned DNA in 1% agarose gel.
Run 1 µl of DNA in Qubit (high sensitivity assay kit) and 1 µl in NanoDrop.

steps.title: End-Prep Reaction
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNA for adapter ligation.

substeps.instruction: Based on Qubit reading, take 500 ng of cleaned DNA in 25 µl nuclease-free water.
Mix by flicking and spin down.
Incubate in a thermal cycler (lid temperature 70°C) for 10 minutes at 20°C and 30 minutes at 65°C.
Add 1 volume (30 µl) of resuspended AMPure XP beads and mix by flicking.
Incubate on a Hula mixer for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Spin down and pellet on a 96-well magnet rack; pipette off the supernatant.
Wash beads with 200 µl of fresh 70% ethanol; remove and discard. Repeat.
Spin down, place on magnet, pipette off residual ethanol, and air dry for 3-5 minutes at room temperature.
Resuspend pellet in 15 µl nuclease-free water by flicking and incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Pellet beads on magnet until the eluate is clear and colorless.

steps.title: Barcoding and Dilution
steps.instruction: Barcode the DNA and adjust concentration for the next stage.

substeps.instruction: Quantify 1 µl of end-prepped DNA using Qubit high sensitivity assay kit.
Dilute the sample to 80 ng in a final volume of 9 µl in a new strip tube.
Mix by flicking and spin down.
Incubate the reaction for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Add 20 µl of resuspended AMPure XP beads and mix by flicking.
Incubate on a Hula mixer for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Spin down and pellet on a magnet; pipette off the supernatant.
Wash beads with 200 µl of fresh 70% ethanol; remove and discard. Repeat.
Spin down, place on magnet, pipette off residual ethanol, and air dry for 3-5 minutes at room temperature.
Resuspend pellet in 12 µl nuclease-free water and incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Pellet beads on magnet until the eluate is clear and colorless.

steps.title: Pool Barcoded Samples
steps.instruction: Pool samples to achieve a high concentration for adapter ligation.

substeps.instruction: Quantify 1 µl of barcoded DNA using Qubit high sensitivity assay.
Add 36.4 ng of each barcoded sample into a 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube to reach a final concentration > 400 ng.
If volume exceeds 50 µl, perform a 2.5x volume AMPure XP bead cleanup with a final elution volume of 52 µl nuclease-free water.
Quantify 1 µl of the pooled DNA to confirm concentration is > 400 ng.
Incubate the reaction for 10 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Adapter Ligation Cleanup
steps.instruction: Clean up the adapter ligation reaction and prepare the final library.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend AMPure XP beads by vortexing and prepare 1 ml of fresh 70% ethanol.
Add 40 µl of resuspended AMPure XP beads to the adapter ligation reaction and mix by flicking.
Incubate on a Hula mixer for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Place on magnetic rack, pellet beads, and pipette off supernatant.
Add 140 µl of Adapter Bead Binding buffer, resuspend by flicking, pellet on magnet, and pipette off supernatant. Repeat.
Resuspend pellet in 15 µl Elution Buffer by flicking and incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Pellet beads on magnet until eluate is clear; remove and retain 15 µl of eluate in a clean 1.5 ml Eppendorf DNA LoBind tube and store on ice.
Quantify 1 µl of adapter ligated DNA using Qubit high sensitivity assay to ensure concentration is close to 200 ng.

steps.title: Flow Cell Priming
steps.instruction: Prepare the MinION flow cell for library loading.

substeps.instruction: Prepare the priming mix in a 2 ml Eppendorf tube.
Open the MinION lid and slide the priming port cover clockwise to reveal the port.
Remove any small bubbles under the cover by drawing back a few µls using a P1000 pipette set to 200 µl (turning the wheel to 220-230 µl).

Load 800 µl of priming mix into the priming port. To prevent air bubbles, pipette ~830 µl, drop a small amount of liquid to cover the port before attaching the tip, and slowly pipette out, leaving ~20 µl in the tip before removing.
Wait 5 minutes.
Gently lift the SpotON sample port cover.
Load an additional 200 µl of priming mix into the priming port (not SpotON port) using the same technique as the previous priming step (pipetting ~230 µl).

steps.title: Library Loading and Sequencing
steps.instruction: Load the prepared library onto the flow cell and start the run.

substeps.instruction: Thoroughly mix the contents of the RBF and LLB tubes by pipetting.
Mix the prepared library gently by pipetting up and down just prior to loading.
Add 75 µl of sample to the flow cell via the SpotON sample port in a dropwise fashion, ensuring each drop is absorbed before adding the next.
Quickly replace the SpotON sample port cover, close the priming port, and replace the MinION lid.
Run the MinION sequencer.
